title: Obstructions to coloring arithmetic graphs
summary: The arithmetic graph $B_n$ joins distinct $a,b\in\N$ when $\max(a,b)/\gcd(a,b)\le n$. We prove $χ(B_{205})=206$, disproving the conjecture that $χ(B_n)=n$ for every $n$, equivalently the Rainbow Cascades Conjecture. The proof reduces an arbitrary tiling by the arithmetic exponent tile to a periodic tiling, then to two families of finite quotients, which are excluded using exact computations. We also construct a $208$-coloring using $\Z_{104}\times\Z_2$ and prove $212\leχ(B_{211})\le213$.
